title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji found secret correspondence between the mastermind behind the humiliation of broken engagement and a senior minister of the imperial court. The wax seal on the confidential letter bore the personal seal of a current senior minister—this was not merely revenge for the broken engagement humiliation, but involved a fraction of the power struggle for the throne and Heavenly Secrets' grand design.

text.content: Dusk spread like ink, drenching the forests surrounding Tianqing Sect. The Crown Prince's Estate's spies, like hungry wolves catching the scent of blood, had already established multiple hidden sentries within a hundred li of Tianqing Sect. Yet at this moment, Chen Ji stood at an unassuming cliff edge, his gaze piercing the heavy darkness to the flickering firelight in the distance—the bonfires of Xuanwu Sect's vanguard camp. The external enemy had arrived, and an even more dangerous killing intent was quietly approaching from within.

dialogue.content: "Xuanwu Sect's forces arrived three days earlier than anticipated." The voice of the remnant soul guardian echoed from the Tianji Record Fragment, carrying a hint of gravity. "It seems someone has provided them with precise intelligence."

text.content: The corner of Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward, the arc carrying a touch of sarcasm. The information he had deliberately leaked three days ago had indeed attracted forces from both sides—one was the visible Xuanwu Sect, while the other was the hidden mastermind behind the broken engagement, waiting to harvest. "Excellent. The flies have finally revealed themselves."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji sensed someone approaching from the shadows. How should he deal with this potential killing intent?

choices.description: Pretend to notice nothing, letting the enemy believe they have the upper hand, then eliminate them all in one sweep once fully exposed.
choices.visible_cost: Risk: May fall into a passive situation if judgment is wrong
choices.visible_reward: Gain: Can lure enemies into an even deeper trap
choices.risk_hint: The enemy's patience may exceed expectations

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息，如同融入夜色的幽灵。片刻后，他能清晰地感知到那股杀气——来自东南方向，至少三人，皆是练气后期的好手。
"Interesting." Chen Ji暗道，"不是玄武宗的人，杀气中带着世家独有的阴狠。退婚那笔账，该算了。"
就在此时，一道火光突然在远方山头冲天而起——那是玄武宗的信号箭。紧接着，喊杀声如潮水般从外围传来。外敌的probing性攻击，正式开始了。

dialogue.content: 一道霸道的声音划破夜空："陈机！给老子滚出来！"

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly—Han Lie, Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, had actually come in person. He stood with hands clasped behind his back at the cliff edge, his gaze piercing through the heavy night curtain to a figure on the distant mountaintop—the Xuanwu Sect's command platform. However, the person standing on the command platform was not Han Lie.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly—the person wore Xuanwu Sect elder robes, with a composed and steady demeanor, directing operations with mastery. And this person's face bore a seventy percent resemblance to a senior minister from the Crown Prince's Estate! All the fragments in his mind connected into a shocking answer—the mastermind behind the broken engagement humiliation, the Crown Prince's Estate's informant, and Xuanwu Sect's external invasion—the three were connected by such an intricate web of secrets!

choice.prompt: Internal turmoil and external invasion struck simultaneously. Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: The assassins in the shadows are the real threat. This hidden danger must be removed first before dealing with external enemies.
choices.visible_cost: May miss direct confrontation with Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Completely eradicate the conspiracy forces behind the scenes
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's destructive power cannot be underestimated

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flashed, plunging into the shadows. Three dark figures followed closely, their qi locking onto the spot where he had just stood. They clearly hadn't expected this 'waste' to be so vigilant.

choices.description: Since Han Lie came knocking, take this opportunity to reshape the 'waste' image, letting enemies continue to underestimate.
choices.visible_cost: Hidden forces may seize the chance to escape
choices.visible_reward: Publicly crush Han Lie, shocking everyone present

text.content: Chen Ji stepped into the air, facing the sky full of firelight. Below in the shadows, several killing intents quietly retreated—they thought the prey was seeking death, exactly what they wanted.

dialogue.content: When Han Lie saw Chen Ji still dared to appear, he was first stunned, then burst into wild laughter: "Hahaha! Chen Ji! Your life is truly stubborn! But today, you will surely die!"

text.content: Chen Ji paid no attention to Han Lie's bravado. He reached into his chest, pulling out a communication jade talisman he had prepared long ago, and gently infused spiritual energy. Moments later, a miserable scream came from the distant mountaintop—the Xuanwu Sect elder's scream.

"What happened!" Han Lie's expression changed drastically. He turned to look, only to see that elder had fallen from the command platform, life and death unknown. Xuanwu Sect's formation immediately fell into chaos.

dialogue.content: "Han Lie, did you think you were the only one who could summon people?" Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold, the corner of his lips curving into a dangerous arc. "Your master's scheme ends today."

text.content: At the same time, in the dense forest to the southeast, three dark figures had crept to the spot where Chen Ji had stood. However, all they saw was a note pasted on the rock, with four characters written on it—'Been expecting you.' "Bad! It's a trap!" The leading shadow shouted, but before the words finished, countless formation runes lit up all around them—the Beast-Confinement Formation! They had been counter-encircled!

choice.prompt: The assassins are already in the jar. It's time to close the net.

choices.description: Leave no survivors. Completely eliminate the assassins to avoid information leakage.
choices.visible_cost: May lose leads to trace the mastermind

text.content: Chen Ji formed a seal with one hand. The Beast-Confinement Formation tightened abruptly. Three screams rang out almost simultaneously, then returned to silence moments later. The three Qi Refining stage assassins never even saw Chen Ji's face before they perished, their cultivation paths ended.

choices.description: Leave at least one person alive. Only living witnesses can pull out the mastermind.
choices.risk_hint: The assassins may have last-ditch self-destruct techniques

text.content: Chen Ji modified the formation, trapping only two of them while deliberately leaving a gap in front of the third. That person predictably took the bait, fleeing desperately—yet on their body, Chen Ji had long ago implanted a tracking technique.

choices.description: Deliberately let one person go, have them bring false intelligence back to lure out the snake.
choices.visible_reward: Can uncover the entire chain of interests in one move
choices.risk_hint: If the other side detects it in time, all efforts may be wasted

text.content: Chen Jisneered一声，故意在困兽阵上开了一个口子。那人仓皇逃窜，却不知自己已经成了陈机棋盘上最新的棋子——他的每一步，都在陈机的预料之中。
Chen Ji负手立于崖边，遥望两处战场。远处，玄武宗的阵势已经彻底崩溃，韩烈正陷入天青宗弟子的围攻之中；而东南方向的密林里，三道黑影已无一能逃出困兽阵的范围。"既然来了，就都留下吧。"他淡淡开口，声音calm得近乎cold。
Chen Ji缓步走向困兽阵中，从为首刺客的尸体上搜出一封密信。他借着远处的火光展开，瞳孔slightly一缩——密信上的火漆印记，赫然是当朝某位重臣的私印。信中的内容，更是让他眸光一寒：皇位之争的布局、天青宗的覆灭计划、以及……一个他从未想过的名字。

dialogue.content: "第一卷目标已完成三成。"墨先生的声音在脑海中响起，带着几分gratified，"但要小心……天道之眼已经注意到了你的存在。"

text.content:
Chen Ji抬头望向夜空，仿佛看到了那双无形的眼睛正在注视着他。这一夜，玄武宗先锋营大败而退，太子府的眼线铩羽而归，而那封密信上的名字——与天道之眼在人间布局的冰山一角，似乎正在渐渐浮出水面。

"越来越有意思了。"Chen Jiwhispered道，眼底深处闪过一抹深邃的光，"这盘棋，我接了。"
